listing.name: Astartes Minipack
listing.summary: Adds a Space Marine Battle Barge, a Thunderhawk fighter, and a few hand-painted player portraits.

description:
Astartes Minipack

A small, simple mod which adds a Space Marine Battle Barge, a Thunderhawk fighter, and a few hand-painted player portraits.





MagicLib is required for the included paintjobs.

The Fraternitas-Class Battle Barge is a 55 DP Low Tech capital ship with built-in broadside Macrocannon batteries. The Thunderhawk Gunship is a heavy fighter with some serious firepower, available in wings of two for 20 OP. Both have separate versions for the Hegemony and Luddic Church, and can be obtained from those factions' military markets.

Paintjobs:
Spoiler

Portraits:
Spoiler

Changelog:
Spoiler
Version 1.1.0

-Added Iron Hands portrait
-Added Thunderhawk fighter LPC with two variants
-Added single-shot version of the Heavy Mauler for the Thunderhawk
-Added single-shot version of the Mining Blaster for the Thunderhawk (LC)
-Added Version Checker support
-Fixed capitalization of sounds directory
-Minor sprite and portrait tweaks

Battle Barge:
-Swapped out Ground Support Package for a semi-custom hullmod (same effect as Advanced Ground Support but with different flavor text)
-Modified the non-LC standard variant (put Mark IXs in the large hybrid slots to free up OP for Thunderhawk wings)
-Increased deployment points and maintenance cost to 55
-Fixed unintentionally high fuel/ly. jump cost
-Added it to the Hegemony's priority list so it can actually spawn in their markets
-Removed it from the Mercenary faction
-Removed the Luddic Church version from the LC blueprint package
-Added it to sim opponents and title screen variants

And they shall know no fear.
